name: HC26c: Suppressed viral load
description: Number of active ART clients who reached 6 months on ART, had a viral load test during the reporting period, and had a suppressed viral load result.  Counts unique active ART patients who reached six months after ART initiation during the reporting period, had a VL test during that period, and had a valid suppressed viral load result.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
WHERE r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL

  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) >= :startDate
  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
      < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
      WHERE s.patient_id = r.patient_id
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
      WHERE v.patient_id = r.patient_id
        AND COALESCE(
              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date
            ) >= :startDate
        AND COALESCE(
              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date
            ) < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
        AND v.is_suppressed = 1
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = r.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
